emails.subject: Hawker Heroes - final build date moved up
emails.text:
Hi Wei Ling,

We have a certification slot on Wednesday, so we need the final build earlier than the kickoff schedule said. Please deliver the final build by Tuesday 17 November 2026, 6pm SGT.

The milestone payment stays the same once the build is accepted. I know this is tight - call me if the team needs to talk through what can move.

Thanks,
Priya
Starfruit Publishing

emails.subject: Indie Arcade SG booth allocation
emails.text:
Hi Daniel and Wei Ling,

Here is the final booth allocation for Pixel Kampung. Your booth is 3m x 2m, not the 3m x 3m in the earlier exhibitor pack. We had to reflow the floor to fit the extra showcase row.

You still get one table, two chairs and one power point. The 3m x 2m footprint is the total including your banner, so please keep the roll-up inside it.

Setup is on 26 November from 4pm. Let me know if you need a second power point.

Hafiz
Indie Arcade SG

emails.subject: Starfruit Publishing November newsletter
emails.text:
Hello from Starfruit Publishing.

This month: three partner games hit their wishlist targets, a recap of the regional indie showcase, and a note from our certification team about Android 14 edge-to-edge layouts.

No action needed from you. We will send the December schedule separately.

The Starfruit team

emails.subject: Exhibitor handbook and parking
emails.text:
Hi exhibitors,

The exhibitor handbook is ready. Parking passes are limited to one per booth and must be collected at the loading bay desk. Wi-Fi credentials will be in your welcome pack.

Load-in times are staggered; your slot is in the handbook. Please do not arrive before your slot because the loading bay will be closed.

See you at Indie Arcade SG.
